text:
rachel_ae: Starting a thread for AlderTrust POC - they need SSO + SCIM + RBAC validation before legal signs. Main asks: SAML IdP config, SCIM delta behavior, delegated admin, domain proofing, data residency. Also they asked for a rough Dedicated vs Hosted cost comparison up-front.
idp_ops: Hi Rachel - welcome. We need the IdP metadata XML and the ACS/EntityID they want. They mentioned Okta and Azure AD; both are supported. For high-security tenants we support SAML with signed assertions and request encrypted responses.
rachel_ae: noted. @nate_eng can you confirm whether we support signed assertions + SP-initiated login and whether we expose SAML session duration controls?
nate_eng: Yes - we support signed assertions and both SP and IdP initiated flows. Session duration can be set per-tenant on Dedicated/Private. For Hosted we default to 8h token TTL but can be shortened via policy.
lin_sec: Security checklist to prepare: MFA requirements, SCIM SCHEMA mapping, audit log retention, SOC2/AICPA docs, penetration testing window. They also asked about bring-your-own-key for logs and backups.
toni_se: On SCIM: we have incremental delta tokens and full sync. Default SCIM rate limit is 15 req/s; we can increase for Dedicated. We flatten nested groups and support group entitlements in the 'roles' extension: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:roles. Example group payload supported.
idp_ops: For delegated admin via SCIM we support role-scoped provisioning (e.g., group mapped to admin role). We recommend limited scope for admin groups.
rachel_ae: Legal question: domain proofing and tenant isolation - do we require DNS TXT verification or will a verified corporate email list suffice?
lin_sec: We support DNS TXT verification for domain ownership. Verified email proof (via challenge to admin emails) is supported as an alternative. Tenant lock (preventing new user signup for unverified domains) is available on Dedicated and Private; for Hosted we offer tenant lock with an addendum.
toni_se: On user counts: they estimated 28k users and ~1200 groups; peak concurrent sessions unknown but expect 3-5% concurrency initially. That maps to about 840-1400 concurrent sessions. We'll need to size inference capacity based on model choice; I'll coordinate with solutions.
infra_bot: Note: no active region incidents for eu-central-1.
nate_eng: SCIM mapping notes for their Okta -> Redwood sync: map okta.profile.email -> userName, okta.id -> externalId, okta.profile.firstName/lastName -> name.givenName/name.familyName, okta.profile.active -> active. We accept group.members as list of externalIds.
rachel_ae: Pricing ballpark please - Hosted vs Dedicated baseline for a POC with medium throughput (few hundred reqs/min).
toni_se: Ballpark: Hosted usage pricing depends on token volume; for inference-heavy workloads estimate $Xk/month. Dedicated baseline (reserved pool) typical starting commit is 8k-15k/month depending on instance type and region. For POC we sometimes do a time-limited trial with credits - I'll flag that. Exact numbers to be provided by finance.
lin_sec: Data residency: we can pin region for Hosted (logs and data stored in-region). For Dedicated and Private, customer controls network and storage locality. Cross-region replication happens only with customer approval and contract.
idp_ops: Operational notes: For SCIM initial full sync we recommend scheduling during off-peak. For delta we provide change tokens; if token lost, client should fall back to full sync. We provide webhook for provisioning events as an optional integration.
rachel_ae: Action items: 1) @idp_ops upload SAML metadata and sample ACS/EntityID 2) @toni_se request preliminary Dedicated quote and POC credit approval 3) @nate_eng provide a short SCIM mapping doc and example payloads 4) @lin_sec attach SOC2/DPA links and summary on KMS options.
idp_ops: I'll upload metadata and a sample Okta export by EOD.
toni_se: I'll start the quote and ask finance about a small POC credit; loop me in on numbers needed.
nate_eng: I'll draft the SCIM example and post it here. Example we accept: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"jdoe@alder.com","externalId":"u-789","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"},"active":true}
lin_sec: SOC2 report link: https://redwood.example.com/reports/soc2; DPA template: https://redwood.example.com/legal/dpa. For KMS we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM integrations for Private deployments.
rachel_ae: Great. We'll schedule a 30-min technical presales call tomorrow to walk through SCIM and SAML specifics. Closing notes: keep thread for artifacts and short updates. :thumbsup:
